role: ours expanded fit feature cache; formal baselines and native v1 are untouched

scope.answers: Exactly the frozen 3,046 additional fit-only replay plans.
scope.claims: Exactly 25,864 lexical microclaims; 16 punctuation-only records are deterministically excluded.
scope.calibration: No calibration path is present or opened.
scope.official_test: No official-test path is present or opened.

native_formula_binding.primitive: float32 causal softmax attention(q,s) * repeated V-head L2 norm
native_formula_binding.claim: mean over unique lexical post-token query positions
native_formula_binding.previous_answer: strict position < query; current query token excluded
native_formula_binding.head_readout: mean over heads; full claim-sentence layer-head CSR retained as float16

window_geometry.statement: Each new answer geometry is independently hashed from exact token IDs, absolute positions, offsets, and lexical eligibility. 653,979 is the frozen retained+new arithmetic; label-bearing window files are not opened here.

outputs.layout: One label-blind exact coordinate row per answer.
outputs.semantic_units: Exact source-sentence and scored-claim text for later frozen NLI scoring.
outputs.exclusions: The 16 punctuation-only microclaims with deterministic reason.
outputs.cache: One independently committed/resumable NPZ per answer plus global CSR index.

load_config.padding: one unpadded sequence and explicit all-ones mask; generation_config is not used

model.limitation: These are common Llama-2-7B replay representations, not native states of the five original generators.

stage_gate: prepare -> cpu-check -> separately invoked extract -> status; no training/scoring command
